rule: Internship/graduate/trainee title or job-type signal, or junior/entry-level/working-student signal plus business topic in title/tags. Senior titles excluded. Descriptions alone never establish eligibility. okemprego additionally uses its explicit experience level and Portuguese internship title terms.

attribution.requirement: Link back to Arbeitnow.com on your platform (API terms section 11).

meta.terms: This is a free public API for jobs, please do not abuse. I would appreciate linking back to the site. By using the API, you agree to the terms of service present on Arbeitnow.com
meta.info: Jobs are updated every hour and order by the `created_at` timestamp. Use `?page=` to paginate. Read more information here: https://www.arbeitnow.com/blog/job-board-api

country_policy: Country remains blank: API has no structured country field.
